limitations: Historical previous-observation lags can span several calendar days. Recorded sales are subject to stockout censoring. The evaluation uses actual test-period historical lag inputs (one-step-ahead). No same-day stock_on_hand, units_sold, or lead_time_days is used as a predictor; availability of calendar holiday flags at prediction time is assumed. Class-balanced training and fixed threshold may produce many false alerts. Stockout labels and sales are observational, not proof of causal stock savings.
